# Test fixtures

Public-domain portraits from Wikimedia Commons, downsized to 640 px for the face tests. Two photos each of two people so tests can check that same-person embeddings match and different people don't.

| lincoln2.jpg | [Abraham Lincoln November 1863](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Abraham_Lincoln_November_1863.jpg) (Alexander Gardner) | Public domain |
| douglass1.jpg | [Frederick Douglass (circa 1879)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Frederick_Douglass_(circa_1879).jpg) (George K. Warren) | Public domain |
| douglass2.jpg | [Frederick Douglass by Samuel J Miller, 1847-52](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Frederick_Douglass_by_Samuel_J_Miller,_1847-52.png) | Public domain |
